description:
**[Winner of the 4th World Comic Contest]**

Hae-joon was having a normal day. He returned home from his part-time job, and there was a man standing in his room where no one should be?! He even passed through a wall and disappeared before my eyes... I thought it was a dream, but what was the identity of Si-yoon, the man I met again the next day?
